entries.name: NBA 2K27 Assistance & Training
entries.description: Curved-meter assistance with RHYTHM/TIMING feedback, calibration without a separate tempo grade, bounded timing adjustments and recorded assisted trials. Requires Studio beta.38 or newer.
entries.author: AccessRelay

entries.name: NBA 2K27 Shot Trainer
entries.description: Standing Still, Off-Dribble and Fade-Away shot baselines with isolated shot-input Lua playback. Tap once to play the whole shot; live movement stays manual. Timing and tempo edits retain Run scripts. Requires Studio beta.42 or newer.
entries.author: AccessRelay
